children: Latigo Biotherapeutics reported a net loss of $25.8 million for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 and cash and cash equivalents of $55.0 million as of the same date. The company completed an upsized IPO raising gross proceeds of $397.4 million and said proceeds plus existing cash are expected to fund operations into 2029. R&D expenses were $21.2 million and G&A expenses were $4.6 million for the quarter.
Net loss: $25.8 million for the three months ended June 30, 2026 (also $25.8 million for same period in 2025).
Research and development expenses: $21.2 million for the three months ended June 30, 2026.
General and administrative expenses: $4.6 million for the three months ended June 30, 2026.
Cash and cash equivalents: $55.0 million as of June 30, 2026; company expects cash plus IPO net proceeds to fund operations into 2029.
Completed upsized initial public offering raising gross proceeds of $397.4 million (before underwriting discounts, commissions and offering expenses).

Onzotrigine: NEJM published positive abdominoplasty trial results showing statistically significant pain reduction, rapid relief, favorable tolerability and opioid-sparing potential; Phase 3 bunionectomy randomized trial and a single-arm open-label Phase 3 safety trial planned to start in H2 2026 with topline results expected H2 2027.
Onzotrigine IV formulation: Completed bioavailability studies with preliminary data indicating approximately 100% oral bioavailability.

LTG-321: Initiated a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled within-patient crossover Phase 2 trial in ~120 knee osteoarthritis patients at multiple sites in Denmark; enrollment underway with topline results expected H2 2027.

LTG-418 and discovery programs: Completed 14-day non-GLP toxicology studies for LTG-418 showing suitable tolerability in rats and non-human primates; continued discovery of additional ion channel modulators targeting peripheral pain transmission, including approaches for neuropathic pain.

Leadership: Appointed Naomi Lowy, M.D., former deputy director at FDA's Division of Anesthesia, Addiction Medicine, and Pain Medicine, as senior vice president of global regulatory affairs to support development and regulatory strategy.

title: Latigo Biotherapeutics posts $25.8M Q2 net loss, $55.0M cash and $397.4M IPO proceeds
